svg.title: Pl Icp Step 1
svg.desc: Plot, Step 1 of point-to-line ICP: identify correspondences and target normals n sub i. A blue source scan P lies above a red target curve Q. Gray lines pair source points (0.5, 3.5), (2.5, 4.5) and (4.5, 4) with target points (1, 1), (3, 2) and (5, 1.5). Each target point has a faint tangent line and a red normal arrow perpendicular to it: n sub 1 points up-left, n sub 2 straight up, and n sub 3 up and slightly right.
